The memorandum dated September 1, 2016 containing the City Manager's determination of the emergency is provided as part of this agenda item. A full report will be presented orally at this meeting for the purposes of updating the City Council regarding the emergency.

Council initiated item from Deputy Mayor Shaffer regarding an amendment to Coastal Mobility and Livability Working Group (CMLWG) by-laws.
Approve amendment to CMLWG by-laws to allow the representative of each Stakeholder Organization to designate an alternate attendee at a CMLWG meeting if the named representative is unable to attend.
2016-09-14 Item 12B Amendment to Coastal Mobility and Livability Working Group

Council initiated item from Council Member Catherine S. Blakespear regarding City of Encinitas unfunded pension liability and other post-employment responsibilities.
Direction to staff to provide the City Council with options regarding how to assess and responsibly manage future pension and other post-employment obligations such as retiree healthcare. The options may include an estimate for a customized city study and presentation based on a RFP to actuaries, as well as a less costly GovInvest option.

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
